title: Coaching Youth Sports: Leadership, Learning, and Positive Development
description: This course examines youth sport coaching as a powerful vehicle for leadership, learning, and positive youth development. Students explore the social, psychological, and ethical challenges facing youth sport today, including participation, motivation, safety, and inclusion. Using evidence-based frameworks such as transformational leadership and national coaching standards, students learn how coaches influence athlete development, team culture, and community engagement. Emphasis is placed on practical coaching skills, communication, athlete agency, and reflective practice. Designed for students interested in coaching, mentoring, or working with youth in sport and physical activity settings. Through applied learning experiences, students develop the skills needed to coach youth responsibly and effectively in community sport settings. Ideal for former athletes and students seeking to give back through coaching or leadership roles.
